methodology: Single-worker encoding times; metrics excluded. rc1 compressor (with common current engine and Pillow) versus current bounded-lossy JPEG plus verified lossless jpegtran/oxipng. Standalone jpegtran/oxipng reference is lossless, NOT a matched-quality lossy competitor. These tools are also used by current, so this is a reference baseline, not independent evidence of beating them. No commercial GUI app claim.
